College.name: Malla Reddy Engineering College for Women

Courses: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)

Eligibility.B.Tech: Candidates should have completed 10+2 or equivalent with the required subjects and should satisfy the applicable admission requirements.

Admissions.process: Admission is conducted through the applicable Telangana engineering admission process.

Fees.B.Tech: Fee details vary according to the admission category. Please contact the college for the current fee structure.

Hostel.details: Girls hostel facility is available on campus.

Transport.details: College bus transportation facility is available.

Library.details: The college provides library and digital learning facilities.
